caption: The drawing depicts a wooden writing desk with an upper hutch, rendered primarily in shades of brown and tan with accents of blue and white. The upper portion features two tall, rectangular compartments with doors on either side, each topped with a decorative finial. Between the compartments are four open cubbyholes, two of which have arched tops. Below the cubbyholes, there is a broad rectangular panel that appears to be an additional compartment or fold-down writing surface, distinguished by oval wood grain patterns. The lower portion of the desk includes a blue writing surface area. Underneath the writing surface is a single drawer that spans the length of the desk, featuring two round, white knobs with decorative blue accents. The desk stands on four straight, tapered legs. The background is a plain, light beige color, and the entire composition maintains a focus on the central piece of furniture, with no additional objects or details present in the scene.
title: Cabinet
